messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem. Need owners for: status page copy, 72h external summary, and RCA-sharing policy (redaction + consent). Also include a short note about recurring routing-patterns. Who volunteers?

ben: I’ll do status page blurb. Draft by 2026-03-27 EOD.

liz: I’ll co-own the 72h summary with Jordan for tone/legal. Due 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.

sam: I’ll draft the RCA access policy and a customer consent flow (no customer IDs in public). Target 2026-03-25 COB.

jordan: I’ll attach a short recurring-incident paragraph and link the remediation tracker. ETA tomorrow morning.

ben: Draft posted: "Brief throttling (429s) from a misrouted quota rule affected a small subset of traffic. Mitigation: reroute + hotfix. Next steps: permanent routing guard and improved monitoring. POC: incidents@redwood.com." Feedback?

liz: Remove internal timing and avoid naming customers. Add "what we’re doing to prevent recurrence" bullets and link to live status page.

sam: Legal wants a simple opt-in form for customers requesting full RCAs; default public summary redacted. I’ll draft consent text.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated.

maria: Thanks. I’ll add these deliverables to the action tracker and set reminder nudges 24h before deadlines.
